description:
Shared prompt text that isn't a procedure: identity, brand voice, context, policy. It says nothing about which agents use it; agents list it in `blocks`.

Written as instructions/<id>.md: optional YAML front matter, then the text.

id.description: The file name without .md. Set automatically.
id.title: Id

locked.description: If true, every agent must include this instruction (directly or through a group), or the build fails. Automated suggestions must leave it alone.
locked.title: Locked
